```plato
    // TIGHT bounds of a rotated rectangle: the half-extent along each world axis is
    // the sum of the two local half-extents weighted by |cos| and |sin| — the
    // support function of the box evaluated on that axis.
    Bounds(b: OrientedBox2D): Bounds2D
    {
        var c = b.Rotation.Cos.Abs;
        var s = b.Rotation.Sin.Abs;
        var hx = b.Size.Width * 0.5;
        var hy = b.Size.Height * 0.5;
        return CenteredBounds(b.Center, hx * c + hy * s, hx * s + hy * c);
    }
```

```plato
        => (Point2D(c.A.X.Min(c.B.X) - c.Radius, c.A.Y.Min(c.B.Y) - c.Radius),
```

## Line 483

**Source:** [stdlib/geometry/planar.library.plato, line 483](../../../../../stdlib/geometry/planar.library.plato#L483).

```plato

    // TIGHT bounds for a rotated ellipse: the half-extents are
    // sqrt(a^2 cos^2 phi + b^2 sin^2 phi) and sqrt(a^2 sin^2 phi + b^2 cos^2 phi),
    // the support of the ellipse along each world axis.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ellipse#General_ellipse
    Bounds(e: Ellipse): Bounds2D
    {
        var c = e.Rotation.Cos;
        var s = e.Rotation.Sin;
        var dx = ((e.SemiAxes.X * c).Square + (e.SemiAxes.Y * s).Square).Sqrt;
        var dy = ((e.SemiAxes.X * s).Square + (e.SemiAxes.Y * c).Square).Sqrt;
        return CenteredBounds(e.Center, dx, dy);
    }
```

```plato

    //==
    // # SuperEllipse
    //
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Superellipse


    // CONSERVATIVE, not tight: the world-axis-aligned box of the ROTATED local
    // bounding rectangle [-a, a] x [-b, b], which contains the superellipse for
    // every exponent. Tight only at Exponent -> infinity (the rectangle itself);
    // at Exponent = 2 the tight box is the ellipse formula above, which is smaller.
    // TODO(content): the tight support function of a superellipse is
    // a*|cos t|^(2/n) style and is not attempted here.
    Bounds(se: SuperEllipse): Bounds2D
    {
        var c = se.Rotation.Cos.Abs;
        var s = se.Rotation.Sin.Abs;
        return CenteredBounds(se.Center,
            se.SemiAxes.X * c + se.SemiAxes.Y * s,
            se.SemiAxes.X * s + se.SemiAxes.Y * c);
    }
```
